{{Top|leg}}
'''Hallucinogenic stimulants''' were fast-acting compounds that could be used in assassinations to induce [[dementia]]. [[Scarab Mark VI assassin droid]]s had [[poison injector]]s that were connected to internal reservoirs that could contain hallucinogenic stimulants or fast-acting [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve toxins]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
